text:
Faculty Review: MTSA (BMD)
I wanted to share a review on MTSA sir since Sir is a new faculty and a lot of people are wondering whether to take his course. I did only a lab course under him which was BBT314L. 
If you actually like your major and you like learning, MTSA sir will facilitate that excellently. He delves deep into the practical applications of every concept, explains why it is necessary and talks about a lot of very interesting stuff that you won't find on textbooks. 
Similarly if you do not want to work hard and want a grade handed to you, MTSA is not the faculty for that, which is why liking your major is important here. You can't get away with blindly memorizing slides and just showing up to class, you need to pay attention.
Sir is very kind and nice to all students. He also encourages questions and is eager to answer them. He prefers that you interact more and get your confusions cleared instead of missing marks in the exams. He genuinely wants you to do well and LEARN.
For our lab reports he was very attentive to small details and the length of your writing, this is where I fell short. We're not used to teachers so critically marking lab reports so he might seem a bit picky in this case. But even then the final was easy and so was the viva, very conceptual however. 
In short, take a course under MTSA sir if you're willing to put in that effort. He's particularly passionate about BBT314 I think, so I'm not sure about how things are in BBT230/203. Hope this helped you! If you have any questions ask away in the comments, do refrain from inboxing. Thank you! See less
